messages:
Priya R.: Heads-up — console shows a persistent negative invoice delta for a handful of Dedicated customers after the route-split rollout. Small % but spikes nightly. Anyone seen this pattern?
Dan (Billing): Saw one alert this morning. Looks like invoice_preview has negative line items for route tags that changed after enrichment.
Maya S.: Can you paste an example event? negative invoices usually mean credits got double-applied or an enrichment removed a charge tag.
Priya R.: Example from preview pipeline (sanitized):
```json
{"tenant_id":"t-123","route_id":"rX","tokens":1200,"charge_origin":"proxy","enriched_route_tag":null,"invoice_amount_cents":-300}
```
Priya R.: Note: original event had route_tag=A, enrichment later stripped tag during a late join. Routing split created rX/rY variants.
Kelsey M.: This screams "late enrichment + route aliasing". We currently dedupe on (tenant_id, session_id, timestamp_window) and derive charge via route_tag if present. If enrichment removes tag we lose how to map charge.
Dan (Billing): Two options: 1) keep a stable canonical_route_id at ingest and never overwrite on enrichment, or 2) materialize route_provenance history so preview can reconcile. Option 1 is simpler but risky for long-term accuracy.
Alex P.: From console/UX POV, option 1 is easier for customers — fewer phantom negative previews. But we need to expose provenance in invoice preview rows so teams know why a charge was attributed. Maybe a small "Provenance" pill that expands with: original_route, current_route, enrichment_events.
Maya S.: Agree on provenance. Also we should measure "late_enrich_count" and the latency distribution. Add a telemetry metric that counts when enrichment changes route_tag after initial ingestion.
metering-bot: New metric proposal created: metering.late_enrich.count — owners @Kelsey M., alert: >100/hr across prod.
Kelsey M.: Implementation note: easiest change is to attach an immutable ingestion_route_fingerprint to the event at the first hop (edge/proxy). Then enrichment can add fields but can't mutate that fingerprint. Reconciliation can prefer ingestion_fingerprint if enrichment is missing mapping.
Dan (Billing): Could we run a reconciliation job that replays events and computes a "safe_charge" using resolution order: if enriched_route is non-null use it; else fallback to ingestion_fingerprint->route mapping. That should fix previews and invoices for late-enriched windows.
Priya R.: Sounds good. But also need to update preview pipeline to surface when fallback was used (so finance/support can triage). Add a boolean column `preview_used_fallback` in preview export.
Alex P.: UI: show a warning icon for rows with preview_used_fallback and let users filter them. Also add a rollout toggle for "enable_enriched_routing_preview" so we can canary the enriched-only behavior.
Maya S.: For rollout, canary in preview only (not final invoices) for 48h, track negative_invoice_count and route_provenance_ratio. If negative_invoice_count increases >5% abort.
Kelsey M.: I'll sketch the SQL to detect the negative rows for the canary:
```sql
SELECT count(*) as negatives,
       sum(case when invoice_amount_cents < 0 then 1 else 0 end) as negative_count,
       count(distinct ingestion_fingerprint) as uniq_ingests
FROM preview_events
WHERE recorded_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND tenant_id IN (select tenant_id from canary_list);
```
Kelsey M.: Also will add a streaming sidecar that emits `enrichment.change` events to an "enrichment-audit" topic to compute lag histogram.
Dan (Billing): One edge-case — reseller/integrator routes where we already remap route_id downstream. Make sure ingestion_fingerprint survives edge-proxy route rewriting or we rehydrate mapping at the next hop.
Priya R.: Good call. We should mark those customers and maybe exclude them from the first canary.
Alex P.: Actionable list?
Priya R.: 1) Kelsey: add immutable ingestion_fingerprint + enrichment.change producer (owner). 2) Kelsey/Dan: reconciliation job for preview fallback and `preview_used_fallback` flag. 3) Alex: console pill + filter + canary toggle. 4) Maya: alerting thresholds and canary stop conditions. 5) Dan: update billing docs on how fallback affects preview vs final invoice.
Kelsey M.: Assigned. I'll open a PR for the fingerprint change and wire the metering.late_enrich.count metric.
Dan (Billing): I'll draft the reconciliation algorithm and run it against last 7 days to estimate impact.
Maya S.: I'll add canary runbook and alert playbook.
Alex P.: I'll prototype the UI pill mock and post in #product for feedback.
Priya R.: Thanks team. If anyone sees a spike tonight ping here and @Maya S. directly. :thumbsup:
